rationale: Resolve the census name Inspiration Mobility to the single existing Inspiration Mobility Group platform. Retain Inspiration Mobility Group as the canonical display name and record Inspiration Mobility as an alias. Correct ArcLight's active ownership period to the canonical ArcLight Energy Partners Fund VII, L.P. record, add Macquarie Asset Management and Ferrovial, S.A. as current equity investors, and leave undisclosed percentages and vehicles null rather than inferring them. Correct the additional-capital milestone from September 2024 to its actual May 18, 2022 closing date. Current company, ArcLight, Macquarie and Ferrovial sources support continuing ownership, and no Inspiration-specific sale or pending ownership transfer was identified through August 13, 2026.

identityResolution.platformBoundary: Count Inspiration Mobility Group once. Inspiration Mobility Holdings is the ownership parent; Inspiration Fleet and Inspiration Energy are operating businesses; Inspiration EV, LLC and the acquired Electrada assets are subsidiaries or assets beneath the platform and are not separate PortCos.

ownershipResolution.fund: ArcLight Energy Partners Fund VII, L.P.

ownershipResolution.stake: Minority interest; exact percentage not publicly disclosed

acquisitionExitCheck.entrySearch: ArcLight Fund VII supplied the initial $200 million commitment at the platform's November 10, 2021 launch. Ferrovial reports investing at the end of 2021. Macquarie announced its equity investment in Inspiration Mobility Holdings on May 18, 2022; the company confirmed that the $215 million capital raise from Macquarie and Ferrovial had closed.
acquisitionExitCheck.currentStatusSearch: ArcLight lists Inspiration Mobility as Current, Macquarie retains Inspiration on its current portfolio page, Ferrovial retains Inspiration on its current mobility page, and Inspiration's current About page identifies Macquarie, ArcLight and Ferrovial as its investors.
acquisitionExitCheck.exitSearch: No Inspiration-specific sale, divestiture, IPO, pending buyer or transfer of any of the three investors' interests was identified through August 13, 2026. DigitalBridge's announced acquisition of ArcLight's management platform is a manager-level transaction and does not establish a transfer of Inspiration or Fund VII's interest.
